test_cases.objective: To verify that the system continuously monitors temperature in all GMP storage areas as per URS-EMS-001.

test_steps.action: Set up temperature sensors in GMP storage areas.
test_steps.expected_result: Sensors are correctly placed and operational.

test_steps.action: Monitor temperature readings for 24 hours.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are recorded continuously without interruption.

acceptance_criteria: Temperature readings are recorded continuously
No interruptions in monitoring
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be accurate and complete

test_cases.objective: To validate that the system generates alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from setpoint as per URS-EMS-005.

test_steps.action: Set temperature setpoint to 25°C.
test_steps.expected_result: Setpoint is correctly configured in the system.

test_steps.action: Simulate temperature deviation to 27°C.
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alert for temperature deviation.

acceptance_criteria: Alert is generated when temperature exceeds ±2°C from setpoint
Alert is logged in the system
data_integrity_requirements: Alerts must be accurate and timely

test_cases.objective: Verify that the EMS accurately measures and records temperature within the specified range of -80°C to +50°C with an accuracy of ±0.5°C.

test_steps.action: Set up temperature sources at -80°C, 0°C, +25°C, and +50°C.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature sources are stable and verified with a calibrated reference thermometer.

test_steps.action: Expose EMS sensors to each temperature source for 15 minutes.
test_steps.expected_result: EMS records temperature readings within ±0.5°C of the reference thermometer.

acceptance_criteria: All temperature readings must be within ±0.5°C of the reference values.
No system errors or data gaps during the test.
data_integrity_requirements: All data must be stored in the vendor's standard database format.
Audit trail must record all test activities.

test_cases.objective: Verify that the EMS correctly generates and transmits alarm notifications to the site paging system when temperature deviations occur.
prerequisites: Site paging system configured to receive EMS alerts

test_steps.action: Configure EMS to trigger an alarm when temperature exceeds +25°C.
test_steps.expected_result: Alarm configuration is saved and confirmed in the EMS software.

test_steps.action: Expose EMS sensor to +27°C temperature source.
test_steps.expected_result: EMS generates alarm within 30 seconds and transmits notification to paging system.

acceptance_criteria: Alarm is generated within 30 seconds of temperature deviation.
Paging system receives and displays the alarm notification.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm events must be recorded in the audit trail.

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system generates alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.

test_steps.action: Set the temperature setpoint to 20°C in the system configuration.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the setpoint and displays it correctly.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature reading of 22.1°C using a test sensor.
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alert for exceeding the +2°C threshold.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature reading of 17.9°C using a test sensor.
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alert for falling below the -2°C threshold.

acceptance_criteria: Alerts are generated within 30 seconds of threshold violation
Alert messages include correct temperature values
Alerts are logged in the audit trail
regulatory_basis: EU GMP Annex 11 for alarm management
data_integrity_requirements: Alert records must be complete and unalterable
Timestamps must be accurate to within 1 minute

test_cases.objective: Confirm that the system properly retains data for the required 7-year period using vendor archival features.
prerequisites: System has been operational for at least 1 month
Test data available from previous months

test_steps.action: Access the system's data archival interface using administrator credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays archived data with proper timestamps.

test_steps.action: Attempt to retrieve temperature records from the oldest available date.
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully retrieves complete records without data corruption.

test_steps.action: Verify archive configuration settings for retention period.
test_steps.expected_result: System shows retention period set to minimum 7 years.

acceptance_criteria: System maintains data for at least 7 years
Archived data is complete and retrievable
No data corruption in archived records
regulatory_basis: EU GMP Annex 11 for data integrity
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must be complete and unaltered
Metadata must be preserved with all records

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system generates alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint as per URS-EMS-005.

test_steps.action: Set the temperature setpoint to 25°C in the system configuration.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the setpoint and displays it correctly.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature reading of 27.1°C (exceeding +2°C deviation).
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alert within 30 seconds as per URS-EMS-011.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature reading of 22.9°C (exceeding -2°C deviation).
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alert within 30 seconds as per URS-EMS-011.

acceptance_criteria: Alarms are generated for both high and low temperature deviations
Alarms are generated within 30 seconds of deviation
Alarm messages contain correct temperature values
regulatory_basis: EU GMP Annex 11 for alarm management
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm events must be recorded in audit trail

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system properly retains data for 7 years using vendor's archival feature as per URS-EMS-010.
prerequisites: System has been operational for at least 1 day
Test data available in the system

test_steps.action: Generate test temperature data for current day in the system.
test_steps.expected_result: Data is successfully recorded in the system database.

test_steps.action: Initiate the vendor's archival process for the test data.
test_steps.expected_result: System confirms successful archival of the data.

test_steps.action: Verify archived data can be retrieved and is complete.
test_steps.expected_result: All test data is retrievable and matches original records.

acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully archived without corruption
Archived data can be retrieved completely
Data integrity is maintained during archival process
regulatory_basis: EU GMP Annex 11 for data integrity
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must be complete and unaltered
Data must remain accessible throughout retention period

test_cases.test_name: Integration Test: Alarm Notification with Paging System
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS correctly integrates with the site paging system for alarm notifications using the vendor API.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature deviation exceeding ±2°C from the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alarm condition.

test_steps.action: Check the site paging system for the alarm notification.
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm notification is received on the site paging system within 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: Alarm notification is received on the site paging system within 30 seconds of alarm generation.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure alarm and notification timestamps are accurate and logged.

test_cases.test_name: Performance Test: System Response Time for Alarm Conditions
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS response time for alarm conditions does not exceed 30 seconds.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature deviation exceeding ±2°C from the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alarm condition.

test_steps.action: Measure the time taken from alarm generation to system response.
test_steps.expected_result: The system response time does not exceed 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: System response time for alarm conditions does not exceed 30 seconds.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure alarm generation and response timestamps are accurate and logged.
